description: Land Title Settlement Department - Etamurungagoda, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320315
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in various locations. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land and property-related matters falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
